home.heroSubtitle: Small groups on the Piraeus waterfront. Personal and semi-personal training with real attention for every athlete — no chain, no crowd.
home.sectionCommunityBody: We are not a chain. We are a neighbourhood gym on the shore — we know your name, we greet you at the door, and we train together.
home.philosophyItem1Body: Few athletes per hour, so there is room and time for everyone. Real coaching, every session.
home.philosophyItem2Body: We know your name, your goals and your limits. Training here is personal — always.
home.philosophyItem3Body: A structured programme that builds on the last session. Show up and the results follow.
home.sectionHowBody: Three steps, once. After that a booking takes ten seconds.
home.step1Body: Your contact details and your doctor's note, as a PDF or a photo.
home.step2Body: We review your application and email you the moment you are in.
home.step3Body: Pick a day and a start time. Cancel up to 2 hours before.
home.ctaSectionBody: Join the Brado family. Apply today and start training with a community that actually cares.

story.title: Our story
story.lead: This space was born from a need for something more human in training.
story.body1: The owner's story will go here in Greek (with English translation). Until then, this placeholder invites you to share why Brado opened, what 'family' means in the gym, and what every athlete can expect from day one.
story.body2: Training is personal, in small groups. You do not get lost in the crowd — you progress with purpose, support, and a smile.
story.heritageBody: Some places carry the energy of what came before. This corner of Piraeus has always been about movement, discipline, and the people who show up. We carry that forward.
story.value1Body: Show up. Do the work. Every day is a step forward — no shortcuts, no excuses.
story.value2Body: Training alone is fine. Training together is powerful. We are stronger as a family.
story.value3Body: Not just harder — smarter. Every session is built on the last, moving you forward with purpose.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: A simple process — designed so you feel confident before your first session.
howItWorks.s1Body: Add your contact details and upload your medical clearance (PDF or photo).
howItWorks.s2Body: Brado reviews your application. Once approved, you receive an email.
howItWorks.s3Body: Pick a day and start time. Most athletes choose :00 starts; :30 slots are available too.
howItWorks.s4Body: Few athletes in the room at once — always with space, safety and supervision.
howItWorks.ctaBody: The first step is simple — create your account and we'll take it from there.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Find us on Akti Themistokleous — by the sea.

legal.privacyBody: We collect registration details and medical clearance for safe participation in training. Files are stored securely in the EU and are not shared with third parties except where required by law.
legal.termsBody: Use of the booking platform is for Brado Training Center members. Bookings may be cancelled up to 2 hours before start unless otherwise stated.
